title: ZoozCreatorBoostCampaign
description: Multi-asset creator promotion & ad boost campaign schema supporting video, image, third-party platforms, and affiliate products with budget-to-views estimation models.

id.description: Unique identifier for the promotion campaign.

postId.description: Local post ID when boosting an internal video or image reel.

postTitle.description: Headline or hook shown across FYP promotion overlays.

assetType.description: Target asset format: VIDEO (reels), IMAGE (photos/flyers), PLATFORM (external social channels), or AFFILIATE (commission products).

assetMediaUri.description: Direct URI/URL to the media asset or thumbnail banner.

externalUrl.description: Destination link for platform social channels or affiliate referral URLs.

platformName.description: Name of the third-party ecosystem when promoting external social links.

affiliateNetwork.description: The affiliate program or merchant platform where the product originates.

affiliatePrice.description: Retail price of the affiliate item in USD.

affiliateCommission.description: Commission rate or promo voucher code (e.g. '15% OFF with code ZOOZ15').

budgetCoins.description: Coins allocated for the promotion (1 Coin = $0.05 USD).

durationDays.description: Duration over which ad pacing delivers impressions.

targetClicks.description: Projected CTR of ~6.5% for high-intent FYP viewers.

timestamp.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when created.
